record.name: Plany - AI Travel Planner
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Tell Plany where you're going and it builds the itinerary. Set your pace, pick what you're into, and get a full day planned with real restaurants, cafés, and attractions — organized on a calendar, not buried in a chat log.

Plany is a calendar-first trip planner. Every trip is a visual day-by-day timeline with weather, sunrise and sunset times, and segments that organize themselves as you plan. Share it with whoever's coming — they see the same plan, updating live.

It's also where all the scattered research finally lands. The reel you saved, the restaurant a friend mentioned, the tab you left open for a week — drop it into Plany and it becomes part of the plan instead of something you meant to look up later.

AI THAT PLANS WHOLE DAYS
Choose Relaxed, Balanced, or Packed, pick your interests, and let Plany build the day. It avoids duplicating what you've already added and suggests places that genuinely fit your destination — each with ratings, photos, and one-tap adding.

SAVE IDEAS FROM ANYWHERE
Come across a place on social media? Drop the link in and Plany extracts the location, saves it to your ideas, and makes it one tap to add to a trip. Organize saved places into collections for future trips.

PLAN YOUR WAY
Prefer to do it yourself? Search Google Places directly, browse what's nearby, or mix manual planning with AI suggestions.

NEAR ME
See your events and saved ideas on a map showing what's within walking or driving distance right now. Tap any pin for details, directions, or to jump back to your calendar.

COLLABORATE IN REAL TIME
Share a trip with view-only or full edit access. Set expiry, invite by email, and chat with your travel partners on specific events.

TRACK WHAT YOU SPEND
Log expenses against your trip as you go and see where the budget is actually going.

EXPLORE PUBLIC ITINERARIES
Browse real trips from travelers worldwide. Get inspired for a destination you're considering, then make it your own.

ALSO WORKS WITH CHATGPT & CLAUDE
Already live in an AI assistant? Connect it and plan conversationally — whatever you ask for lands in your Plany calendar, properly organized by day.

RICH EVENT DETAILS
Photos from Google or your own camera roll, notes, location pins, attachments, and [N] event types from Hike to Flight to Spa.

ALSO INCLUDED
Trip export and printable itineraries · Events Library and Day Templates · Dark mode

FREE TO START
Create 2 trips with 15 events each, 5 AI suggestions and 3 full-day AI plans per month, plus 3 share links — free, no card required. Pro is $14.99/month and raises every limit: 50 trips, 250 events per trip, 150 AI suggestions and 30 full-day plans monthly, 30 share links, and up to 10 collaborators per trip. Pro also unlocks file attachments, the Events Library, Day Templates, saved-idea collections, and API access for ChatGPT and Claude.

Terms of Use: https://plany.ae/terms
Privacy Policy: https://plany.ae/privacy

Built by Anytech General Trading LLC in Dubai, UAE.

Book by chatting, not by filling forms.

Someone in your corner, before and during the trip.

Flights, hotels, and experiences. Zenvoya can also help you plan around road trips, vacation rentals, camping, and ferries, and point you to the right place to book those.

Your personal AI travel concierge — the one that actually knows your trip and how you like to travel.

It has your real itinerary in hand — flights, hotel, car rental, tonight's dinner — plus your pace, budget, and interests. So every answer is about your trip, not travel in general.

TRAVLIN AI — ASK ANYTHING, GET ANSWERS ABOUT YOUR TRIP
Open any trip and start a conversation. Travlin AI already knows your dates, destinations, bookings, and preferences, so you never have to explain yourself:

"Put together a full day plan for our first day in Rome"
"What time should we leave for the airport on Sunday?"
"Best way to get from my hotel to the airport?"
"Suggest a dinner spot near tonight's hotel"
"What should I do with a free afternoon on Thursday?"
"Our flight was canceled — find me a hotel near the airport"

A generic AI hands you a list. Travlin knows you land at 6pm, you're staying in the 7th, you're traveling with kids, and you'd rather walk than take a cab — and it answers accordingly.

IT KNOWS HOW YOU LIKE TO TRAVEL
Set your pace, budget, travel interests, and who you're traveling with. Every suggestion, tip, and answer is filtered through it. Two people can ask Travlin the same question in the same city and get genuinely different answers — because they're different travelers.

LOCAL TIPS FOR EVERY DESTINATION
Land somewhere new and already know your way around. Food & Drink, Attractions, Getting Around, and Safety are laid out in clean, tappable cards for every place on your trip — shaped by your dates, pace, budget, and interests.

Not a list of the same ten tourist attractions everyone else gets. Tips that fit the trip you're on.

AND THE ITINERARY BUILDS ITSELF
None of that works without knowing your trip — so Travlin builds it for you. Forward your flight, hotel, car rental, and train confirmations, and they assemble themselves into one clean chronological timeline, with dates, times, confirmation numbers, and addresses already filled in. Works with any airline, hotel, or booking site — completely vendor-agnostic.

No manual entry. No screenshots buried in your camera roll. No flipping between five booking apps. 

FLIGHT DETAILS THAT ACTUALLY HELP
Live status, terminal, and gate appear on your trip screen as departure approaches, alongside departure and arrival times in the correct local time zone. Tap once to call the airline or jump straight to online check-in. Rental car pickup and drop-off details, organized the same way.

TRAVEL TOGETHER
Share a trip with the people you're traveling with. Companions see the same itinerary, so nobody is forwarding screenshots at the airport.

BUILT FOR HOW YOU ACTUALLY TRAVEL
- Travlin AI answers based on your trip and your travel preferences
- Solo trips, family holidays, business travel, and multi-city adventures
- Everything for a trip in one place, in the order it happens
- Add anything manually when a confirmation email doesn't exist
- Your international travel details and preferences kept in one profile
- Your data, your control — Travlin never sells your information

WHY TRAVELERS CHOOSE TRAVLIN
Itinerary apps organize your trip and stop there. AI trip planners give you advice but have no idea what you've actually booked. Travlin is both: a concierge with your real itinerary and your travel style in context, from the moment you forward your first email.

Travlin doesn't book your travel. It organizes and elevates the trips you've already booked — and then travels with you.

Your trip, organized beautifully. Your AI concierge, always with you.

record.name: TravelNest AI
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
TravelNest AI plans trips that actually suit everyone travelling — the allergies, the wheelchair, the dog, and the four-year-old who still naps after lunch.

Most trip planners assume one kind of traveller. This one starts with your travel party. Record each person's age, dietary needs, mobility needs and interests once, and every plan, packing list, phrase card and suggestion is built around them.

PLAN A DAY THAT FITS YOUR GROUP
Tell the app the trip and it drafts a day-by-day itinerary from your own party's needs — with the reason each item was chosen, and the constraint tags it satisfies. Keep what you like, drop what you don't.

KNOW HOW READY YOU REALLY ARE
A single readiness score reads five things at once — the plan, the stays, the packing, your documents' validity against the trip dates, and the budget — and tells you which one is holding you back.

A PACE THAT SURVIVES CONTACT WITH CHILDREN
Overloaded days get flagged before they ruin the trip, against the youngest traveller's limits.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
- Reservations vault — paste a confirmation and the details are pulled out for you to check
- Packing lists generated from the trip's length, your party and the destination's climate
- Documents with expiry countdowns against real renewal windows, and reminders months ahead
- Budgets with a daily burn rate and an "at this rate" projection
- Cost splitting with a settle-up plan in the fewest transfers
- Allergy phrase cards in 12 languages that work with no signal

FREE, ALWAYS
One active trip, up to four travellers, and three AI drafts, answers or translations a month. Documents, packing, budgets, saved places and the offline phrase cards are free with no limit.

TRAVELNEST AI PRO (optional subscription)
- Unlimited trips and travellers
- Unlimited AI itineraries, answers and translations
- Settle-up summaries you can share
- Your full trip history, kept
Monthly or annual, both with a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. The subscription auto-renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends; manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.

A NOTE ON WHAT THE AI DOES
The assistant answers from the trip you have entered — your dates, your party, your saved plans. It does not browse the web and it will tell you when your trip does not hold the answer rather than inventing one. Always confirm entry requirements, opening times and accessibility with official sources and the venue.

record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Pawsport is a travel planner and itinerary app. Tell it where you're going — a city, a country, or just an idea like cherry blossoms or a ski week — pick your dates, and get day-by-day plans fitted to them, with real places grouped so each day stays in one or two areas.

Ask about anything on your trip. Pawsport checks Google Maps for real places, ratings and opening hours, and changes the plan for you when you ask.

Explore any city like a local: top sights, restaurants, cafes, markets and more from Google Maps, with photos and ratings; the basics of getting around; and day trips worth taking. Add anything to a day in one tap.

Keep every booking in one place. Forward the confirmation email, drop in a PDF or a screenshot, or paste the text: flights, hotels, trains, buses, ferries, cruises, hire cars, restaurant tables and shows are sorted and put on the right day.

Follow each day as it happens: your next stop and a countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, widgets for your Home Screen, offline maps for no-signal days.

Keep the trip as you go: check in at each stop, add your photos, and get a logbook and a recap of every day to share.

Plan with friends: share the trip, suggest and vote on places, split the bills.

And catch the cats you meet on the way — every one becomes a card.

Free to use, with three AI plans and ten questions for every trip. Pawsport Pro removes the limits, lets Pawsport check Google Maps and the web as it plans with you, adds planning on your computer, and turns your trip recap into a video.

Pawsport Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
